camofox-live-fixes.ref: statenour/camofox-live-fixes (job 2026-10-18-camofox-live-fixes, 2026-10-18). apps/statenour/ops/egress-proxy/Dockerfile: ENTRYPOINT no longer passes --listen-ip=:: (Smokescreen v0.1.0 builds the address as '%s:%d', so '::' gave ':::4750' and a crash loop every second on Railway; with the flag removed it listens on every interface and the container stays up). New tests/integrations/egress-proxy-dockerfile.test.ts parses the ENTRYPOINT array (comment lines dropped, continuation lines joined) and pins: no listen-ip value with a colon (three spellings), --listen-port=4750, EXPOSE 4750, the eight --deny-range flags by exact set, both FROM lines by sha256 digest, the commit in the ARG, the checkout and the rev-parse check, the documented pin, and no CMD instruction at all (Docker appends CMD args to an exec-form ENTRYPOINT, so a CMD with --listen-ip=:: brings the crash back; found by the manager's review). Red first: 4 failed / 19 passed on the unfixed Dockerfile (the 4 are the unmodified file failing on listen-ip-colon; the first draft's deny-range mutant read 'entrypoint-not-exec-json', a harness defect fixed before the run counted); then the 4 CMD cases 4 failed / 24 passed (28 tests) on the audit before the cmd-present pin. After: egress-proxy-dockerfile.test.ts and camofox-scrape-fallback.test.ts 77 passed / 0 failed. Mutants 6 / 6 killed on the real file: re-add --listen-ip=:: (5 red), drop one deny-range (6 red), strip one digest (6 red), commit changed in the ARG only (4 red), commit changed in the rev-parse check only (5 red), CMD [--listen-ip=::] appended (4 red); a comment that quotes --listen-ip=:: stays green. Runbook docs/runbooks/camofox-scrape-fallback.md and ops/egress-proxy/README.md rewritten to the facts the manager recorded from the live deploy (401 not 403, HTTP 407 on a denied target with the rule in the proxy log, example.com expected text, loopback /health measured, tarball-at-SHA method, three Railway CLI gotchas, project id in Rollback). No change to lib/integrations/camofox.ts, firecrawl.ts or any behaviour.
